# Public Social Account Analyzer
> Agent Skill & CLI toolkit for auditing public creator accounts across Bilibili, Douyin, Weibo & Xiaohongshu with immutable audit artifacts.

Deterministic, auditable public data collection and content analytics for social media platforms structured for AI Agents and LLM ingestion.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/README.md): High-level overview, platform capability matrix, and quickstart commands.
- [Usage Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/USAGE.md): Detailed CLI options, workspace flags, and pipeline parameters.
- [Testing & Quality Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/TESTING.md): Regression suites, test fixtures, and schema validation.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer/main/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated reference documentation including collector contracts.
